entities.name: Osgir
entities.description: Giant professor at Lorehold College, Strixhaven, with an intense passion for antiquities and an expert in duplicative restoration.

entities.name: Lorehold College
entities.description: College of Strixhaven University focused on history.

entities.name: Strixhaven University
entities.description: University on Arcavios containing Lorehold College.

events.summary: As a student Osgir secretly collects and stashes remarkable discoveries from Lorehold's excavation sites in his quarters.
events.quote: Osgir frequently found himself in trouble for secretly collecting and stashing the most remarkable discoveries

events.summary: Osgir becomes an expert in duplicative restoration, restoring and duplicating ancient artifacts for his private collection.
events.quote: His dedication led him to become an expert in the rare magical discipline of duplicative restoration.

relations.note: He is a faculty member there.
relations.quote: Professor Osgir is a Giant who serves as a faculty member at the Lorehold College
